whenToUse: "Was this helpful?" at the end of a help article, docs page or guide.
Collecting a yes/no vote with optional reasons and a short comment, sent through one callback.
avoidWhen: Rating on a scale such as stars or NPS — use a radio group or slider.
A full contact or support form — compose Field, Input and Textarea.
a11y: The section is labelled by the question; vote buttons use aria-pressed and the thank-you and error messages are announced in a polite live region.
Reason chips are a labelled toggle group with roving focus; the comment field has a real label.
